CORE MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #9
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 82
   C. 18
   D. 81

2. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 2/2
   B. They are equal
   C. 1/4
   D. Cannot tell

3. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 10
   C. 5
   D. 26

4. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 169
   B. 170
   C. 13
   D. 26

5. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 12
   C. 24
   D. 42

6. Solve for x: x + 9 = 16. (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 7
   C. 16
   D. 8

7. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 400
   C. 4
   D. 10

8. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 400

9. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 25

10. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 64
   C. 65
   D. 0

11. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 38
   C. 30
   D. 60

12. What is √100? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 100
   C. 11
   D. 50

13. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 44
   C. 22
   D. 30

14. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 6x
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 6x + 2

15. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x ≥ 0 only
   B. x = 5
   C. x < 5
   D. x > 5

16. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 40 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 41
   B. 43
   C. 31
   D. 49

17. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 43

18. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

19. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 81
   C. 36
   D. 18

20. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 24
   C. 48
   D. 144

21. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.7
   B. 25
   C. 19.6
   D. 19

22. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 49

23. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31.7
   C. 31.6
   D. 31

24. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.7
   B. 23
   C. 29
   D. 23.6

25. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 22
   C. 121
   D. 122

26. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 5
   C. 24
   D. 25

27. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.7
   B. 15
   C. 15.6
   D. 21

28. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 27.7
   C. 27
   D. 27.6

29. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

30. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 48
   C. 14
   D. 2
